name: Sudden Geysers
disable: DC 32 Arcana check or DC 32 Nature check (master) to dissipate the fire-aligned energies in the water, or DC 28 Diplomacy check or DC 28 Religion check to beseech Sangeh and convince her to momentarily tamp down her mythic power; two successes are required to disable the hazard
routine: (2 actions) The hazard uses each of its actions to create a Blistering Plume centered on a space chosen by the GM. Each successful check to disable the hazard removes one action from this routine.

items.name: Scalding Gout
items.text:
Trigger A creature within the hazard's area rolls initiative

---
Effect A enormous column of superheated steam rises from the water, dealing 4d12+26 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 28 basic Reflex save save). On a critical failure, the creature also takes 1d12 persistent,fire damage as the water continues to burn their skin. The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.name: Blistering Plume
items.text: A 30-foot-tall geyser erupts from the boiling water. Creatures in a 5-foot emanation of the geyser take 2d12+13 fire damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save save).

text: The pooling seawater burbles and hisses.
